easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
The card used to grant indestructible is affecting Broodhatch Nantuko.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, dealing 1 damage to Broodhatch Nantuko.
Broodhatch Nantuko triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
